# NimoteCode

> NimoteCode is a mobile IDE and SSH workspace for Android, iPhone and iPad. The mobile app works with local files or projects on a development machine reached over SSH.

## Work modes and requirements

- IDE mode opens local files or a remote project with a code editor and Git change review. In SSH workspaces, code and commands run using the host's tools and the connected account's permissions.
- Terminal mode provides interactive access to the selected environment. Local files alone do not provide a Linux shell, compiler, or project runtime. Android Local Linux offers rootless Ubuntu on supported Android devices. iPhone and iPad do not include Android Local Linux.
- AI mode offers optional AI Chat and Agent workflows. The built-in AI uses your own supported provider and API key. The provider bills model usage separately. NimoteCode does not include model credits. Compatible external ACP agents need their own runtime setup and credentials. Claude Code and Codex CLI may run over SSH if installed and authenticated on the host.
- Host mode connects to a running compatible NimoteHost service for host-side workflows such as terminal and Agent sessions and tasks. Using it from a compatible NimoteCode release requires Pro access. Standard SSH remains available without a NimoteHost service.
- Language services and debugging depend on compatible configured language servers and debug adapters. Docker, Compose and Dev Containers depend on a compatible SSH host and Pro access.

## Companion products and availability

- NimoteCode is the mobile client. Download it through [the official stores](https://nimotecode.com/download). The [release archive](https://nimotecode.com/releases/) identifies the current and upcoming mobile releases.
- NimoteHost Community is an Apache-2.0 project with standalone CLI or desktop packages for Linux, macOS and Windows. See [NimoteHost documentation](https://nimotecode.com/docs/host) and [source and releases](https://github.com/mobiledevloperlab/nimotehost).
- Nimote Connect pairs computers and is designed to provide a route to a computer's SSH server. Its published CLI package is a prerelease. Paired public internet access is planned for NimoteCode and plan allowances have yet to be defined. Direct SSH to a reachable address, including a personal Tailscale address, works independently of Connect. See [Connect status and setup](https://nimotecode.com/docs/connect).

## Plans and trial

- NimoteCode offers a Free plan and Pro features. Free includes local and SSH workspaces, editing, a basic terminal, Git review, AI Chat with a provider you supply and basic language services. For the upcoming 2.5.0 comparison, Free includes basic Android Local Linux on supported devices and limited built-in Agent tasks. Pro raises Agent and remote-search limits and includes Host, debugging and supported Docker workflows. The [plan comparison for the upcoming 2.5.0 release](https://nimotecode.com/pro) gives the planned details. Check the installed release for account-specific access.
- Eligible users can claim a 14-day Pro trial in the app. The account returns to Free after the trial unless it has other valid Pro access. Purchase availability, terms and local prices are shown in the app for the current account and store. See [account and subscription](https://nimotecode.com/docs/account-subscription).
